Claim 1 (Currently amended): An association method, comprising: 2 identifying candidate file sets from a plurality of application files, each 3 candidate file set including a cluster of related but unrecognized application 4 files; 5 presenting content indicative of each of the candidate file sets; and 6 associating an application with application files of one of the 7 candidate file sets according to a detected selection of the content indicative 8 of the one of the candidate file set.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The method of Claim 1, wherein the candidate file sets include 2 at least one of a frequent file set, a common application package file set, a 3 common version file set, and a common directory file set.

Claim 8 (Currently amended): A non-transitory computer readable medium having instructions stored 2 thereon that when executed by a processing resource implement a system 3 comprising a file set engine, a presentation engine, and an association 4 engine, wherein: 5 the file set engine is configured to examine a plurality of unrecognized 6 files of two or more computing devices and identify candidate file sets from 7 the plurality, each candidate file set including a cluster of related but 8 unrecognized application files; 9 the presentation engine is configured to present content indicative of 10 each identified candidate file set; and 11 the association engine is configured to detect a selection of content 12 indicative of one of the candidate file sets and associate an application with 13 an application file of that one of the candidate file sets.

Claim 9 (Currently amended): The medium of Claim 8, wherein the file set engine is 2 configured to identify candidate file sets that include at least one of a 3 frequent file set, a common application package file set, a common version file set, and a common directory file set.

Claim 15 (Currently amended): A system comprising a processing resource and a non- 2 transitory computer readable medium and instructions stored on the 3 medium, wherein the instructions, when executed, cause the processing 4 resource to implement a method, comprising 5 examining a plurality of unrecognized application files of two or more 6 computing devices to identify candidate file sets from the plurality; 7 presenting content indicative of each of the candidate file sets and 8 associating an application with the application files of a given one of 9 the candidate file sets according to a selection of the content indicative of 10 that candidate file set.
